propositions: The review-bot-ops runbook lacks the production instance ID and AWS region needed for operators to establish SSM sessions, forcing them to guess during deployments.
The prod instance ID (i-00880b2c7f13527c5) and region (us-east-1) are documented in ADR-0026 and Terraform but not in the operational runbook where SSM deploy operators look.
The runbook must cite var.aws_region and versions.tf as the authoritative source of truth for the region rather than hard-coding it.

The autodeploy.sh script body auto-updates via BOT_PATHS rsync like other source files, but script-only changes trigger no deploy and therefore require manual hand-deployment to take effect immediately.
Installer files (install-autodeploy.sh) and systemd unit files (rebar-autodeploy.{service,timer}) are excluded from in-run re-materialization to prevent self-modification race conditions.
